summary: SSR Mining Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its sale of an 80% ownership stake in the Çöpler mine and related properties in Türkiye to Cengiz Holding A.Ş. and affiliates for approximately $1.49 billion in cash, after working capital adjustments. The transaction, governed by a Share Purchase Agreement dated March 24, 2026, closed on June 24, 2026. The filing includes unaudited pro forma financial statements. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee is mentioned. The seller is SSR Mining, a Canadian company; the buyer is a Turkish holding company. This divestiture removes a significant asset. Watch for regulatory and tax implications of the cash proceeds.
